root_causes.description: A deployment spec change killed the checkout container ('Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted'); its replacement pod cannot start because the sandbox image gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest fails to pull (DeadlineExceeded → ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff), leaving checkout in a crash-loop back-off and serving no traffic.

evidence.query_or_id: Killing: Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted
evidence.observed_value: count=1 container kill event during window
evidence.expected_baseline: no container kill / definition-change events under steady state

evidence.query_or_id: Failed: Failed to pull image "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest": rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = failed to pull a
evidence.expected_baseline: pause/sandbox image already present; no image pull failures

evidence.observed_value: count=4 back-off events; ImagePullBackOff count=4; ErrImagePull count=3
mean=0.018, max=0.057 req/s (checkout not serving) at 07:34-07:41
evidence.expected_baseline: frontend carries ~7.6-8.6 req/s in the same window; checkout expected in the same order of magnitude

root_causes.description: Alternative interpretation: checkout traffic collapses because a downstream dependency (cart, payment, shipping, currency, product-catalog) is failing. Not supported — checkout emits zero server errors and no error logs, and the pod events show a container start failure rather than downstream call failures.

evidence.expected_baseline: a downstream-dependency failure would surface as checkout server errors > 0
dependency failures produce downstream error logs — none emitted, consistent with a non-running container

root_causes.description: Alternative interpretation: the frontend (upstream caller of checkout) originates the incident. Rejected — frontend request rate stays healthy and its error rate is low and non-anomalous, so it is a victim/observer rather than the cause.

evidence.expected_baseline: no anomaly detected across the window

evidence.observed_value: mean=0.063, max=0.171 error rate (low, no anomaly)
evidence.expected_baseline: frontend error_rate < 0.01 sustained indicates a real fault

remediation_steps: Roll back the checkout Deployment to the previous working container definition — the event 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted' shows a recent spec change triggered the kill.

Fix the sandbox image pull failure: pulls of gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest fail with DeadlineExceeded — verify registry/DNS connectivity, use an accessible mirror or pre-seed the pause image on the node, or set imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent.
Restart/verify the checkout pod becomes Ready and confirm checkout server request rate returns to the normal order of magnitude (~7+ req/s) matching frontend traffic.
